Ohhh I can fix this. Weird. I'm going to have to regenerate general.tar.gz and minimal.tar.gz; github screwed me 😅 But mainnet.tar.gz should exist in full now. It'll take ~2 hours or so to fix this entirely. Sorry for this. I'll make some changes to prevent this from happening again. images build on our scheduled run no more than once every hour so that should be the lower limit, but I can change that to a schedule and have watchtower check once every 6 hours only if you think that would be better? Turning it off completely seems not ideal seeing as the network is near 100% is there a way to trigger watchtoweer manually instead of every unrelated change we push to trunk branches? This should be fixed now.
